systems.platform: Paper register of individual sheets with twelve headings, filled by hand in French in blue or black ink, opened anew each January
systems.owner: Ministère de la Sécurité Publique / Police nationale; guide produced with the Association for the Prevention of Torture
systems.tiers: Compulsory in every service where custody is held: police posts, commissariats and services in charge of judicial investigation; the registers and rights letters were piloted in commissariats of the greater Antananarivo region

note: Guide of February 2021 to the custody register, a single-function paper register (class single-function), so no fact for station records. It says custody must also be detailed in the procès-verbal but does not say how the procès-verbal or any complaint record is made.
